spec.name: sprint35_taker_imbalance_qhour_liquid50
spec.hypothesis: At the open quarter-hour, order-flow taker buy/sell imbalance in the first N minutes predicts short-horizon continuation in liquid large-caps, net of realistic costs — distinct from the price-breakout signal already killed twice on illiquid names.
spec.power_argument: 50-symbol liquid basket, entry_per_day_cap=1/symbol -> up to 50 entries/day; 10-12 trading days reaches n>=300-500. Assuming per-trade net-return stdev ~40bps (typical for 30-60min equity holds), n=300 gives ~80% power to detect a minimum net edge of ~9bps at alpha=0.05 (two-sided t-test). This edge threshold is set above realistic round-trip cost (T1 tier) so a pass is economically meaningful, not just statistically nonzero.
spec.symbols: top-50 by 20d ADV from S&P100, excluding all tail-liquidity altbasket names used in sprint32/34
